study: Fixed post-0001 mock galaxy source/LS pilot descriptive odd multipole projection, no observed odd signal
registration_timing: After first mock0001 pair orientation report but before computing any mock xi multipole from galaxy rows. This is a SOURCE-informed, post-pilot descriptive QA stage, not an independent preregistered hypothesis test.
required_RR_support: all 6x24 cells in both caps, as seen in already archived first fixed pilot; stop if unavailable on replication, no zero filling
fixed_projection: For each separation bin, approximate xi constant within each positive-RR-supported mu bin; xi_ell(s) = (2ell+1)/2 sum_j xi(s,j) integral_{max(-1,mu_j)}^{min(1,mu_{j+1})} P_ell(mu) dmu. Use exact antiderivatives for ell=0,1,2,3. Clip integration domain to physical [-1,1] to exclude 1e-7 buffer beyond poles. Report all six s bins for each cap independently; do NOT coadd caps with ad-hoc weights.
exact_odd_reverse_parity: For ell=1 and ell=3, independently reversed tracer orientation projection must sum with forward to abs <1e-10 per separation bin; even ell reversed projection must match forward to abs <1e-10. These are implementation algebra checks, not physical odd null conditions.
archive_pair_reproduction_gate: Before projection, re-read the 8 full original gzip files under exact original source SHAs, reproduce 8 selected sample array SHA256s and exact archived weighted pair histogram SHA256s for each cap and orientation. Refuse silent recomputation on mismatch, report failure without updated bins/seed.
prohibited: No new tracer selection, no angular re-veto, no common hard mask, no observed galaxy or odd data, no statistical significance, no template tuning, no physical-null claim, no covariance from one sample, no source-dependent change to s/mu/z bins.
interpretation_note: The mock odd ell1/ell3 can be nonzero because finite shot noise, tracer asymmetry and realistic selection/window effects exist. Their numerical values from ONE mock and finite 600D/1200R are not compared to a hypothesis or treated as a detection; also the reverse parity check is an algebraic identity and does not imply xi_odd=0.
next_if_pass: For a quantitative physical null and an 18D covariance, freeze and SHA-audit an adequate many-realization realistic mock-galaxy cohort with matched tracer-specific published randoms. Previously chosen nine IDs remain a preliminary code-transport cohort only.
